---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

`Batting` has about 128,000 rows, with one row per player per season per team going back to 1871. A player with a fifteen-season career therefore contributes roughly fifteen rows.

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player_name = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
    steroid_era_status = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Career overlapped 1994-2009",
      "Career did not overlap 1994-2009"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = reorder(player_name, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era_status
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Steroid era activity",
    values = c(
      "Career overlapped 1994-2009" = "#D55E00",
      "Career did not overlap 1994-2009" = "gray70"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Active means the player's career overlapped 1994-2009. Source: Lahman database."
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
